title: India just ran its first train that burns less diesel by mixing in natural gas
sources: Indian Infrastructure, October 2026 - Centre launches India's first LNG powered train in Gujarat
Adda247 Current Affairs - India's First LNG-Powered Train Flagged Off from Sabarmati
caption:
India just ran its first train that burns less diesel by mixing in natural gas. No new engine needed - the old ones were converted.

India's first diesel-LNG dual-fuel train was flagged off on September 27, 2026, running between Sabarmati, Ahmedabad and Mahesana Junction in Gujarat. Two existing Driving Power Cars were retrofitted for dual-fuel use, each carrying a 2,200-litre LNG tank and completed over 2,000 km of field trials before entering commercial service. LNG can substitute roughly 40% of diesel usage, with a full tank giving about 1,600 km of range.

Not a new train. Not a new route. Just an old engine, rebuilt to burn cleaner.
